page.notes: Printed page number reads "188" (the first digit is a worn 1). Catchword "nec" at bottom right. Doubtful readings: "reconiugali" is set without a visible hyphen at the line end, so joined; "rarò" (line-end "ra" / "rò", no printed hyphen) joined; "filios" (line end "fili" with a worn mark, "os" next line) joined; "creuis-set" hyphen partly worn, read as "creuif-fet" in the print, given as "set" per Latin sense; "Gen.38." numeral is faint; "vir. i." spacing as printed. Stray marks at the start of lines ("'" before "re filios", and "*" beside "fili") are print debris, not text. "funt:" read as "sunt:" (long s). Printed u/v and long s normalised as per the rules.
